d:
Mamata Banerjee launched a sharp attack on the BJP and Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar during the INDIA bloc rally at Delhi’s Ramlila Maidan. Taking a sarcastic dig at the CEC, she mocked the allegations surrounding vote manipulation with a playful twist on the nursery rhyme “Yes Papa”. She also praised CJP. Why did Mamata bring CJP into her speech, and what was her message to the BJP and the Election Commission?

Video Editor: Ved Prakash
